whatThisIs: A recording from the contract-state experiment: sixty real amendments, held out of a portfolio of real SEC EDGAR exhibits, arrive one at a time. For each, the engine first drew the change's ImpactEnvelope (every derived object it could reach: an upper bound, not a forecast of what will change), then recomputed only the envelope's objects whose inputs had moved (the RecomputePlan), and recorded what actually changed (the StateDelta).

modes.bucket: bucket-guard baseline: the predecessor engine, every edge reads its whole blocking bucket
modes.certificate: certificate-aware: SUPPORT, GUARD (per reference, per scope) and the rule version

mutations.oracle: a new engine rebuilt from nothing on the documents, scopes and rules after the change

scenarios.scenario: add a second candidate satisfying the same reference
scenarios.why: a second distinct text of ACME's credit agreement of the same date, same agent: nothing the source states tells them apart

scenarios.scenario: add a candidate satisfying a different reference
scenarios.why: ACME's credit agreement of another date: same filer and type, another reference
the same agreement filed again with a conformed-copy legend: one text, so the edge stands, but its guard moved
the same bytes under another record id: one text
an amended and restated agreement of another date: it answers another reference, and gets its own edge

scenarios.scenario: change the source's role to an annex
scenarios.why: the amendment's text becomes an annex attached to another instrument: an attachment acts on nothing

scenarios.scenario: change the operative citation to historical-only
scenarios.why: the source becomes a second restatement that recites the original only as history

scenarios.scenario: change a historical citation to operative
scenarios.why: the source starts as a second restatement reciting the original; it becomes the amendment that acts on it

scenarios.scenario: expand the authorization scope to a second satisfying text
scenarios.why: room-1 holds a second distinct text of the same agreement; r0 gains room-1

scenarios.scenario: expand the authorization scope to another reference
scenarios.why: room-1 holds ACME's credit agreement of another date; r0 gains room-1

scenarios.scenario: shrink the authorization scope past the target
scenarios.why: the target sits in room-1; scope all loses room-1

scenarios.scenario: shrink the authorization scope past an unrelated room
scenarios.why: scope all loses room-1, which holds only other filers' documents
a refiled copy of the target is revised into a distinct text: two texts now satisfy the reference
the rules change: an amendment that does not define its agent no longer binds

scenarios.scenario: control: an unrelated document is added
control: an unrelated room is added
scenarios.why: r0 gains room-2, which holds another filer's documents

scenarios.scenario: control: a formatting-only change to the source
scenarios.why: the amendment refiled with other line breaks and spacing

scenarios.scenario: control: a second satisfying text outside the scope
scenarios.why: the second distinct text is added in room-1, which r0 cannot see

scenarios.scenario: control: an unrelated reference gains a candidate
scenarios.why: ZENITH's credit agreement gains a second text; ACME's edge rests on none of it

relationship_audit.independence: the only held-out set: frozen (results/audit4_labels.json, committed) before any adjudicate/5 or certificate code existed; scored once
relationship_audit.readers: blind model readers on a frozen rubric; not people

relationship_misses.candidate_generation: 2 of the 73 related pairs are not in the reference-blind generator's top 20 (pd38a181704, p9bd8f2b080)

classes.BINDER: the reading was right; a binder invariant that does not yet exist would have decided it
classes.FEATURE_READER: the evidence is in the text, but the reading that runs before the binder (references, dates, parties, instrument, title vocabulary, text identity) did not produce it
classes.STRUCTURAL: the relationship has a shape the engine does not represent: one instrument acting on several agreements, or a relation that does not mutate an agreement

misses.what: an amendment to an executive employment agreement whose reference to the agreement was not parsed: the source has no dated reference
a second amended and restated note: the target's date was read as 2015-02-11 where the reader found November 8, 2019
a consent and waiver under a settlement agreement: neither document's parties could be read
an amendment to an equity incentive plan: no reference and no parties were read
a supplement to a dealer agreement whose reference to it was not parsed; the target has no date
an amendment profiled as a base agreement, so it never acts as a source
a 'Fourth Restated' agreement: the title vocabulary reads 'amended and restated', not 'restated' alone, so no relation starts
two filings of one financing agreement are not recognised as one text (their parties were read in another order), so the reference stays ambiguous
the conformed annex attached to the source's own filing satisfies the reference beside the original: an annex of the source's own filing is its result, not its target
an omnibus amendment acting on a note purchase agreement, a security agreement and a pledge agreement at once
the same omnibus amendment; the readers name the security agreement it reaffirms
a consent letter under a credit agreement: consent does not start a family edge in this engine
